title: Negative residue cohomology of a proper flat line-bundle direct image
statement: Let f:X→S be flat, proper and locally finitely presented. Let L be an invertible module on X. Fix derived-category localizations for every scheme. For any scheme W, morphism k:W→S, and w∈W, put E=R(f_W)_*(L_W[0]). Then H^j(Li_w^* E), evaluated on Spec kappa(w) and restricted to kappa(w) along GammaSpecIso, is a zero module for every j<0. No descent, structure-unit assumption, or immersion is required.

source.place: Tags 0BF2, displayed derived fibre equality before the first source complex; 0BF0; 0B91(2)

proof.text: Tensor pullback and ordinary pullback are the same left adjoint to pushforward. Transport invertibility of L_W through this isomorphism, giving finite local freeness and finite presentation. On affine opens, its sections are projective and flat over the structure ring; scalar-tower transitivity with flatness of f_W gives relative flatness. Derive additivity of every tensor pullback from its left adjunction and choose standard localizations for the open sites of W.

Unpack the defining derived pullback comparison at the single complex. Form the canonical derived module base-change map at Spec kappa(w) and apply perfect_derivedDirectImage_baseChange to make it an isomorphism. The Lean proof now obtains a derived-to-ordinary comparison c, its comparison predicate, and invertibility of its direct-image composite from exists_isIso_canonicalModuleBaseChange_of_isFlatOver. The comparison is local data inside the theorem proof; the statement and the resulting cohomology object are unchanged.

The isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor corollary of the proved unbounded/bounded-below compatibility says that the right-derived image of the ordinary fibre module has no negative cohomology. Transport its zero homology along the base-change isomorphism. Evaluation sends its identity to zero; hence its global sections are subsingleton. Restriction of scalars changes only the action, so the derived fibre cohomology vector space is subsingleton, and thus a zero ModuleCat object.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_directImage_fibre_cohomology_negative
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) (w : W) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    ∀ j : ℤ, j < 0 → IsZero (derivedFiberCohomology W E j w)
